verdict.rationale: Pipecat's own docs say developers can swap speech services among 200+ integrated providers, usually with one line of code, which supports plugging in multiple providers. The evidence never names specific TTS providers or describes voice selection, so TTS breadth is implied rather than shown. missing for 10: explicit list of supported TTS providers, documentation of voice selection or a voice library, TTS-specific configuration docs, independent hands-on corroboration of switching TTS voices.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose from a broad voice library or plug in multiple TTS providers to get the voice I want
